pages.headline: Credit has approved the deal. The closing specialist opens counsel’s email, the condition checklist and the loan file to find what still blocks funding.
pages.body: An approval waiting on closing conditions. Signed terms that differ from booking. A covenant exception without a disposition. A renewal pack missing current evidence. A portfolio signal needing investigation. A borrowing-base variance awaiting explanation. Each requires facility context, an expert decision and a verified record. Orcaworks coordinates the handoffs across lending systems, documents, borrower reporting and email.
pages.callout: Credit conditions remain idiosyncratic, not systemic.
pages.calloutSource: Rich Gumbrecht, CEO · Secured Finance Network, April 2026

pages.eyebrow: 01 / Loan operations · Credit approval to clear-to-close
pages.title: Closing condition orchestration
pages.problem: Credit approval is in place, but the facility is not ready to fund. The closing specialist checks the commitment, condition checklist, entity documents, lien or title evidence, insurance and executed agreements while chasing borrower and counsel replies. One unresolved condition or unapproved waiver can keep the whole transaction from reaching clear-to-close.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks maps each condition to its evidence, owner and unresolved question, then prepares targeted follow-ups. Loan operations clears conditions within delegated authority; credit and counsel approve material exceptions or waivers before the authorized readiness state and funding handoff are recorded.

pages.eyebrow: 02 / Loan operations · Approved terms to consistent records
pages.title: Approval, documents and booking
pages.problem: The signed loan or lease documents are ready, but an approved term does not match the agreement or booked record. Operations compares rates, fees, maturity, collateral, guaranties and covenants across the credit memo, document set and core. The team must distinguish a clerical correction from a substantive change needing credit or legal approval.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks prepares a field- and clause-level comparison of approved, executed and booked terms, with source references. Operations resolves permitted clerical issues; credit and counsel approve substantive variances before authorized document, execution or booking corrections are confirmed in the exception record.

pages.eyebrow: 03 / Portfolio monitoring · Missing or failed evidence to disposition
pages.title: Reporting and covenant exceptions
pages.problem: A borrower’s reporting package is overdue, incomplete or shows a failed covenant. The portfolio analyst checks facility definitions, financial periods, compliance certificates, calculation outputs and prior waivers, then searches borrower correspondence for an explanation. Credit needs to know whether the case is missing evidence, a data problem or a breach before deciding the response.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks assembles the applicable requirement, evidence and prior decisions, then prepares the exception and borrower request. Credit or committee approves waivers and escalation; the facility record retains a satisfied, waived, breached or open status with rationale and next action.

rightContent.quote: Effective monitoring and reporting systems are the foundation of prudent ABL risk management

pages.eyebrow: 04 / Credit review · Prior rationale to current decision
pages.title: Renewal and annual-review assembly
pages.problem: An annual review, maturity or amendment approaches and the underwriter starts rebuilding the facility story. The prior credit memo, current financials, collateral reports, payment history, covenant results and borrower emails live in different places. Missing entities or periods can hold up the pack before anyone reaches the changed risk or renewal decision.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks assembles review evidence around the prior approved rationale, identifies missing periods and highlights material changes. The underwriter or portfolio team performs credit analysis; the designated authority approves renewal terms before the review record and approved facility changes are retained.

pages.eyebrow: 05 / Risk monitoring · Portfolio signal to owned response
pages.title: Portfolio change investigation
pages.problem: A dashboard flags worsening receivables, changing utilization, a payment pattern or declining availability. The portfolio manager compares current and prior financials, aging, borrowing-base reports, covenant results and borrower replies to establish whether the signal is a data anomaly or a material change. The next action still needs an explained case and credit authority.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks links the signal to its underlying records and prior position, then prepares the changed facts and unresolved questions. Portfolio and credit specialists decide investigation, rating, limits or conditions before an approved disposition, rationale and next review point are recorded.

pages.eyebrow: 06 / Collateral monitoring · Availability variance to reviewed action
pages.title: Borrowing-base exception investigation
pages.problem: A borrowing-base certificate or advance request produces an availability exception. The collateral analyst compares receivables aging, inventory, eligibility rules, concentrations, prior certificates and borrower journals to explain the variance. The calculation engine has produced an answer, but someone must determine whether the cause is a data defect, ineligible collateral or a material out-of-formula position.
pages.opportunity: Orcaworks connects the engine’s exception to source reporting, facility rules and prior certificates, then prepares the correction path. Collateral and credit authorities approve material overrides or holds; authorized corrections rerun through the existing engine before the disposition is retained.

pages.headline: Start with one approved deal awaiting close
pages.body: Choose a live facility with outstanding closing conditions. We’ll map the approved terms, required evidence, borrower and counsel handoffs, and delegated clearance authority with your operations team. Agree the baseline and completion criteria, then demonstrate an authorized clear-to-close disposition in the existing workflow before expanding across monitoring, review and collateral exceptions.
